idea-plugin.name: Sefin One Dark Theme
idea-plugin.description:
A polished One Dark-inspired theme for JetBrains IDEs, actively developed and maintained.

The theme preserves the familiar One Dark feel while adding a refined color palette, improved interface readability, and a more consistent IDE appearance. Its darker, cooler palette works well during long coding sessions, especially on OLED and QD-OLED displays.

Available themes

  • Sefin One Dark
  • Sefin One Dark Vivid
  • Sefin One Dark Islands
  • Sefin One Dark Vivid Islands

Recommended setup

  1. Try Sefin One Dark Vivid Islands, then turn on Settings > Advanced Settings > Enable Islands UI for custom themes.
  2. Turn off Smooth Scrolling.
  3. Turn on Compact mode.
  4. Turn off Settings > Editor > General > Appearance > Show hard wrap and visual guides.

After installation, select the theme in Settings > Appearance & Behavior > Appearance.
For Islands variants, turn on Settings > Advanced Settings > Enable Islands UI for custom themes.
Visit the project repository to learn more.
